cartridges.description: Distinct cartridges of the training and validation rows, the ones dealt.

velocitySigma.description: Velocity sigma of the fit, a fraction of the velocity.

powders.description: Powders fitted.

notFitted.description: Powders not fitted, by reason; a reason without powders is left out.

exponent.description: With `--exponent family`: the pressure exponents of the fit.

pooled.description: The exponent of least mean chi square over all powders that entered.

families.description: By powder family, the exponent it chose.

pressure.description: With `--pressure-sigma`: the burn coefficients come from a second fit, in which the printed pressures of the training rows join the velocities, each over the factor of its key of `--pressure-factor`.

sigma.description: Pressure sigma of each row, a fraction of its printed pressure over the factor of its key.

by.description: The key of `--pressure-factor` a factor is computed per and applied by: `basis`, the pressure basis (`unstated` without one); `table`, the table label (`unstated` without one); `cartridge`; `table-cartridge`, `<table>/<cartridge>`. A result without it reads as `basis`.

factor.description: The model peak pressure times this is what the rows of the key read: the exponential of the median log of printed over model peak pressure of its rows under the fit to velocities only.

rows.description: Pressure rows of the key of the powders fitted to velocities.

factors.description: By key of the training rows; a key without a row of a powder fitted to velocities is left out, and its training pressures are not read.

factor.description: The energy-level factor the prior impetus values were scaled by.

energyFamily.description: With `--energy family`: each powder's energy is fitted with its burn coefficient, under a Gaussian prior on its log centered on its family's median impetus (or `pooled`) over its own gamma minus 1.

fullWeight.description: Rows the fit uses (with `--folds`, those of the other four folds) and their cartridges at which a powder's weight is 1: its weight is min(1, rows / `rows`, cartridges / `cartridges`) and its prior sigma the spread times the root of the weight. The reference powders are those of weight 1.

familyMinimum.description: Fewest reference powders a family needs for its own center.

impetus.description: Median record impetus, (gamma - 1) times the energy, J/kg.

sigma.description: Spread of ln impetus: 1.4826 times its median absolute deviation, at least 0.02; the prior sigma of a powder of full weight.

powders.description: Reference powders it is taken over.

families.description: By powder family (propellant base and grain form), the center of its reference powders; a family with fewer than `familyMinimum` is left out and its powders take `pooled`.

impetus.description: Median record impetus, (gamma - 1) times the energy, J/kg.

sigma.description: Spread of ln impetus: 1.4826 times its median absolute deviation, at least 0.02; the prior sigma of a powder of full weight.

powders.description: Reference powders it is taken over.

pooled.description: The center of all reference powders.

fit.description: The fit on the training and validation rows of the other folds; a powder only this fold names has no fit row and counts as `noUsableRow`.

basis.description: The split whose used rows set the half width: `training`, or with `--folds` the training and validation rows the fit read.

halfWidth.description: The 90th percentile of the absolute relative velocity error on the training split: the interval is the model velocity times (1 +/- this). Null without a training row, and at the top of a `--folds` result, where each row is scored with the half width of its fold, which comes from the training and validation rows of the other folds.

trainingRows.description: Used rows of `basis` the half width comes from; at the top of a `--folds` result the sum over the folds, in which each row counts once for every fold whose half width it sets.

interval.description: The half width of the fit, on the training and validation rows of the other folds.

inSplit.description: Rows of the split in this group.

used.description: Rows the model gave a result for.

notUsed.description: Rows not used, by reason; a reason without rows is left out.

median.description: Median of the absolute relative error, as a fraction.

p90.description: 90th percentile of the absolute relative error, as a fraction.

velocity.description: Absolute relative error of the muzzle velocity over the used rows; null without one.

byBarrel.description: The velocity and pressure errors per barrel class: `handgun`, a barrel under 300 mm, else `rifle`. A class without a used row is left out; a result written before it has none.

pressureByBasis.description: The pressure error per basis, the measuring method a row prints (`transducer`, `case-contact`, `piezo`, ..., `unstated` without one); a basis is never compared with another. A basis without a used row in bar is left out.

coverage.description: Share of the used rows whose printed velocity is inside the interval.

interval.description: Coverage of the 90 % interval; null without rows or without an interval.
